This occupation centers on the demolition, measurement, material preparation, patching, and quality handoff of industrial refractory linings; building structural masonry and mechanical component repair must be compared separately.

Tasks include removing damaged lining, preparing materials at specified proportions, measuring and cutting, patching ladles and furnace walls, and drying or curing per the process; the job title does not grant permission to work inside a furnace.

subject.name: Refractory materials repairers (except brickmasons)
subject.summary: Refractory materials repairers build or repair the linings of high-temperature equipment such as furnaces, kilns, and ladles using refractory materials: they check drawings and dimensions, remove damaged lining, prepare materials, lay or patch, and record quality. Shutdown isolation, confined spaces, dust, and high-temperature risks must be confirmed by authorized personnel per on-site procedures.
